title: Njiitu réew miñu fal
intro: Ci jamonoy jafe-jafe yu metti ak ñàkka am yaakaar ci askan wi, Yàlla dafa tànn nit ñi. Nit ki ñu bari bàyyi wuñu woon xel ci ndoorte li, Yàlla tànn ko ngir mu jiite askan wi di xeex ak noon bu mag. Seen jaar-jaar dafay firndeel dooley ngëm ak xel mu ñaw mi nekk ci ginaaw dogal bi Yàlla tëral, di wane ni njiit lu dëggu du saa yu nekk la nekk ci barab bu ñu yaakaar.
clues: Yàlla tànn nama ma nekk njiit ci sama askan bi ñuy wut njiit luy xeex ci yoonam.
Bi ñuy tàmbali, samay mbokk dañu laaj sama liggéey ndax dañu jàppoon ni ñeneen ñi ñoo ko gëna yelloo ndax seen alal wala seeni mbokk.
Mandargay sama njiit lu jaadu mooy delloosi benn kees bu sell, bu defoon mbiri yonent yu njëkk ya, loolu indi jàmm.
Ma yóbbu samay soldaar ci benn dex, ma tere leen naan lu ëpp benn kaasu ndox ngir natt seen déggal.
Doonte limu nit ñi baña xàddi ginaaw natt gi bariwul woon, danu jànkoonte ak xarekat bu am doole ak seen larme.
Ci sama ndigal, amna xale bu góor bu bokk ci sama larme, te nekkul woon ab xarekat bu siiw, mu jàkkarloo ak noon bu mag bi, ba noppi daaneel ko.

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Ñu taxawal benn buur bu bari alal ak doole.
Mbënd mu mag moo laal nit ñi.
Ndaw si noon bi daanu, Yàlla defal ko ndam li.
Bekkoor bu metti sonal na réew mi ay at yu bari.
Mbindéef mu rëy wann njiit li.
outcome.answer: Ndaw si noon bi daanu, Yàlla defal ko ndam li.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
